method: The existing offline rules are evaluated as binary positive (SUSPICIOUS/FRAUD or a structural indicator) versus negative. Reputation providers are not called.
limitations: Synthetic fixture metrics are rule-path sanity checks only; they are not real-world accuracy estimates.
The UCI SMS corpus is old, English-heavy, and not representative of Indian UPI scams. Spam and fraud are not equivalent labels.
URL and QR fixtures test structural warnings. Reputation providers are mocked by omission and are never contacted.
Results measure this fixed rule set and threshold. They do not establish production-grade performance.

public_dataset_metrics.source: Almeida, T. & Hidalgo, J. (2011), SMS Spam Collection, UCI Machine Learning Repository
public_dataset_metrics.preprocessing: Read the original tab-separated label and message; map ham to negative and spam to positive. No text normalization beyond the detector own NFKC/casefold processing. Spam is only a broad proxy, not equivalent to fraud or UPI scams.
public_dataset_metrics.collection_date: Underlying message collection dates are not fully specified by UCI; donated to UCI on 2012-06-21.

excluded_public_dataset.preprocessing: Reviewed but excluded from raw-URL metrics: its 30 columns are engineered features, not URL strings, so they cannot exercise this URL parser.
